export interface ToolbarTarget {
    readonly active: boolean;
    state(mark: Mark): MarkState;

    apply(changes: FormattingChanges): CommandResult;
    clear(): CommandResult;
    dispose(): void;

## Contract and outcomes

anchor takes a node ID, offset and optional Bias and returns an AnchorToken. Release it when finished. Capture a toolbar target before a host control moves focus; undefined means no usable target. Its state/applicable methods query the mark; format/apply/clear use the prepared command owner. Dispose the capture on dismissal.

## Errors and recovery

Collapsed, stale, removed or protected targets may disable an action. Never turn a failed capture into an edit at the current DOM caret. Re-capture only after explicit user intent and a fresh selection.

## Prerequisites and platform limits

Selection offsets and stable anchors follow the admitted core schema. Browser selection mechanics are not actual IME/assistive-technology or native proof.
